_comment: DISCOVER-AQ (P-3B, 2011/2013CA/2013TX/2014) shared family map; longest-prefix match of column names.

family_long_name.optical: In-situ aerosol optical measurements (TSI-3563 nephelometer, PSAP; ambient extinction)
family_long_name.microphysical: In-situ aerosol microphysics: number concentrations and dry size distributions (LARGE CPCs; SMPS, DMT UHSAS [PSL], TSI APS/OPC)
family_long_name.aerosol_composition: In-situ aerosol composition (PILS ions and WSOC, SP2 black carbon)
family_long_name.ccn: Cloud condensation nuclei concentrations (LARGE CCN counter)
family_long_name.state_nav: Aircraft state and navigation (P3-B Data System)

family_comment.microphysical: 2013CA quirk: the LARGE-SCAT and LARGE-ABS ICARTT files reuse the CNC title 'Particle Number Density Measurements', so their scattering/absorption columns land in this family.
